# AgentLayer Agent Wallet

> AgentLayer is a local wallet for AI agents. It connects supported hosts to balances, payments, swaps, DeFi, and x402 services while keeping signing and wallet policy on the user's machine.

Use the local wallet when the user wants their own agent to inspect a portfolio, send or receive assets, swap, use DeFi, or pay for an x402 service. Read-only wallet operations can be performed directly; any operation moving funds must follow the wallet's preview, policy, and approval flow. Use the hosted x402 MCP only when a remote MCP connection is needed; it has a narrower product surface than the local wallet.

## When to use AgentLayer

- [Agent Wallet](https://www.agent-layer.tech/wallet): Use for a user's local wallet on Solana, Base, or Ethereum, including balances, transfers, swaps, and DeFi. Install with `npx --yes @agentlayer.tech/wallet@latest install`; then use the wallet tools exposed in the connected agent host.
- [Hosted x402 MCP](https://x402.agent-layer.tech/mcp): Use for a cloud agent that needs to discover and pay for x402 services through a remote MCP connection. Connect this URL in an MCP host that supports remote servers and OAuth.
- [Onboarding](https://www.agent-layer.tech/onboard): Use when a user wants to connect GitHub or X and claim a welcome invite for the local wallet.

## CLI and integration

- [Official npm CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentlayer.tech/wallet): The published `wallet` command supports `status`, `doctor`, `detect --json`, `update --yes`, and `mcp config`. Use `npx --yes @agentlayer.tech/wallet@latest install` for first-time installation.
- [Agent skill](https://www.agent-layer.tech/skill.md): Prerequisites, install flow, and guidance for agents helping a user set up AgentLayer.
- [Documentation](https://docs.agent-layer.tech/): Product capabilities and setup details.

## Website API

- [OpenAPI](https://www.agent-layer.tech/openapi.json): Contract for the website's onboarding endpoints only; the wallet runtime and hosted MCP are separate interfaces.
- [API policy](https://www.agent-layer.tech/api-policy.md): API version header and deprecation signals.
- [Sitemap](https://www.agent-layer.tech/sitemap.xml): Public pages on this site.
